reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:fcfa28001d4a705f0892b3a95b6fc798]] I love how easy they are to apply! It’s a good quality for the price as well

I did not have money so I could not purchase the more expensive brands so I was nervous to buy something cheap. Magnetic eyelashes for under $8. Yeah right!!  But guess what? These are perfect. There are 5 pros from the least thickness #1 to the most thickness #5. I am wearing#4. At first it look so thick and long but when I put it on I realize that I can use this for everyday work, it not standoutish. Keep in mind I am wearing glasses so it maybe a more noticeable for someone without glasses. S

While the eyelashes are beautiful, they are VERY hard to use if you can't get a nice line of the eye liner applied and that seems to be an impossible task.  The eyeliner is dried out and clumpy.  These were purchased in November for my daughter as a Christmas gift.  She finally got to using them three weeks later... she handed the gift back to me saying, "Thanks, but these things suck."  I gave it a try, and holy cow, she was very right.  I think you could be using a CRAYON and get better result

I started researching magnetic eyelashes/eyeliner for a while since several started popping up on my social media. They were more expensive and didn’t have as good of reviews as these. So I purchased these and I absolutely love them! Super easy to use and I love the fact that it doesn’t pull out your lashes like glue does. Good quality and great value! I will definitely purchase these products again!
They are so light weight you can barely feel them. They are SUPER easy to put on. Only downfall is if you mess up putting them on it will take the eyeliner off and you will have to reapply.

reviews.t: worth it. EDIT - NOT WORTH IT
reviews.x: Since receiving I've used a pair of lashes EVERYDAY so yes these are def worth it for the price. With the price and such a big demand for these types of lashes bc once again VERY easy to use it could come a lil deflective like mine. My eyeliner wand was frayed a lil bit but i can still use it after cutting the frayed parts off. UPDATE- after a good almost 2 weeks using these i would have to say im disappointed. the wand has frayed beyond belief and the liner is starting to lose its strength. my

reviews.t: Pretty but liner is like a tattoo
reviews.x: These are super easy to apply and look great!  My eyeliner looked like a 3 year old applied it but the lashes covered it up.  Removing the eyeliner was quite a chore.  The directions say to use makeup remover so I used a high quality eye makeup remover.  I used it repeatedly,  then I used cleanser, then more makeup remover.  After 20 minutes of scrubbing with cotton balls, q tips, washcloths, and my fingernails,  I finally got it off.  My eyelids are sore.

Love this lashes, my daughter introduced them to me after I went to a local eyelashes place for a set of lashes but when I laid down to get ready my anxiety level when up after the girl told me I need it to be with my eyes closed for at least hour and half (I left the place couldn't do it)  I am so happy I ordered them, they are easy to use , very light,  stay well and very natural.

I am super impressed with these magnetic eyelashes for the cost! First time I wore them it was a super windy day and they didn’t budge! Very easy to apply and remove. Liner came off with makeup remover. No mess and reusable! Love the selection of lash thickness as well! Got many compliments and have recommended them to many friends already!

The lashes are absolutely beautiful, but they did not stay on. I followed the directions and tried several times. I ended up giving up after the fourth pair and just throwing them out. I would not recommend unless you have a ton of time to try to figure out how to get these things to work.

Would consider purchasing those eyelash cleaner brushes with a lash lift as well as case to keep them safe. these eyelashes work never irritated my eyes and never hurt coming off had these for 2 years they are rather difficult to clean and the eyeliner works on non magnetic lashes as well

The eyeliner is very think and heavy on your eyelids ! The actual lashes are very long so unless you have larger shaped eyes and eyelids the lashes will be too long and not look right ! They also don’t feel good on my eyes extremely heavy and uncomfortable - probably will never wear

Great magnetic eyelash set! These were super easy to apply and stayed on all day. And you can’t beat the price for 5 pairs. I also liked the diversity of having all different styles to choose from. My only complaint is that the eyeliner is a bit flaky and tough to take off.

reviews.t: Quedan lindas y se mantiene en su lugar!
reviews.x: No suelo usarlas diariamente sólo en algunas ocasiones y no me gustan las más grande, prefiero que se vean más natural. Quedan muy bien y son còmodas,  tuve que cortar un poquito por mi tamaño de ojos, el delineador es igual que otros pero es un poco difícil de quitar!

These would be better if they had a clear band holding the lashes onto the magnets. The black band is too thick to look natural.  The eyeliner is a really small tube. And it is sticky and really thick. The eyelashes are super bushy, and have to be trimmed up to wear.

I really wanted to love this, but unfortunately they just don’t work for me. I can’t get them to not look completely fake. The magnets on the eyelashes are just not in the right place and they stick out on the side of my eye. I love the concept though.

reviews.t: Awesome product easy to use highly recommend
reviews.x: These are fabulous ! I’ve always wanted to try false eyelashes and decided to try these, 16 hours and they still never budged ! I put them on like a pro and got compliments all day on how pretty my eyes were. Will use them regularly now !

I finally got around to trying these and the liner is thick and unusable. It goes on in chunks. The lashes are pretty and I was looking forward to using them, but they're not useable without a working eyeliner.

The natural eye lash is very nice. The others are too full. The glue clumps up after one use. It's a waste of money if only 1 eye lash looks good and the glue clumps up and difficult to remove from eyes.

reviews.t: The Best Magnetic Lashes I’ve Used
reviews.x: I’ve tried several brands of magnetic lashes and could never get them to work right or stay on. These go on and stay on really well. I like that there’s a variety of lash styles too. Great purchase!

reviews.t: Yes - too good to be true
reviews.x: The eyeliner is thick and doesn’t go on very smoothly. The lashes were way too long so I cut them in half, hoping to use them on the outer corners of my eyes...looked strange. Tossed the whole kit.
Works well and was simply to use! They have a pretty good hold too! Took me a good sec to get them off but def worth the buy! I had been wanting to try them for so long and Im glad I did!
Super easy to use.  Looked great for my special occasion.  Suggestion though:  use baby oil or Vaseline to remove liner.  Once I tried that, the liner came off easily.

reviews.t: Why are there 5 star reviews for this?!
reviews.x: The eyeliner was disgusting! The smell the stickiness the goopiness/no flow it was like trying to use a single hair to paint thickening tar onto my poor eyelid!!
I liked easy to use, but the glue dry very fast and you have to buy an extra glue liner , I used it in 2 eyelashes and the glue was already dry

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the lashes as easy to apply and use.
Many reviewers consider the product good value for the low price.
A common complaint is that the eyeliner is difficult to remove, thick, sticky, or flaky.
Some reviewers report the lashes did not stay on or were hard to get to work.
Several reviewers mention the lashes are lightweight and comfortable.
